name: Deliverer's Wreath
description: A wreath that Amphoreus offered to {NICKNAME}.
story:
The laurel leaves praise your wisdom, the gold reflects your nobility, and this stands as proof that you once belonged here.

"From this day forth, your name shall no longer be your own alone, mortals will swear by your name.
Wear this glorious yet lonely laurel crown, hero... and merge into the pages of the epic."
